title: doit desk-nudge panel
description: One step of the desk nudge's panel. The watch keeps the today step in $XDG_CACHE_HOME/doit/desk-nudge-panel.json, `doit desk-nudge panel show --json` prints it, and `doit desk-nudge panel pick --json` prints the step a pick leads to. `view` is the service's desk panel view as the watch last read it, whole, and `rows` are what the step draws, so no reader holds the rule that lists them. The other fields are what only this desk knows. This file is the source of the shape, and a Go test validates each document the watch writes against it.

shown_pick.description: A pick of a row, from the panel page or a terminal, which the watch commits at once. The panel shows it while it runs, and how it ended.

id.description: The pick's UUIDv7, which a pursuit's journal entry is kept under.

text.description: The row's text when it was picked.

action.description: What the pick does: complete its row, or record or take back one set of a checklist item.

state.description: committing while its command runs, then how it ended. done went through. skipped found the habit already done on the day it was picked, so nothing ran. refused recorded nothing, so its row can be picked again. uncertain may have landed, as a timeout may, so its row is held until the view is read again.

minutes.description: The minutes it logs for a timed pursuit.

message.description: What it did, or why not, once it ended. Null before.

step.description: today's parts, a timed pursuit's minutes, or done once a pick has acted.

message.description: What a done step did. Null on every other step.

read_at.description: When the watch began the read that the view comes from, on this desk's clock. Null before the first read.

generated_at.description: When the service computed the view. Null before the first read.

stale_since.description: When the first of the reads that have failed since the last good one ended. Null while the latest read went through.

stale_reason.description: Why the latest read failed: unreachable, login, or unreadable, with the error's detail. Null while the latest read went through.

view.description: The service's desk panel view as the watch last read it, whole, with its own schema_version. Null before the first read.

rows.description: What the step draws, in order. Today lists the notes, the suggestion, the answers while a nudge is ready, then each row that a pick completes. A picked row stays, showing how its pick stands. A minutes step lists its amounts, and a done step lists none.

key.description: What `panel pick` takes. Null on a note.

kind.description: What the row completes, as the view names it, or what else the row is: a note, an answer to the nudge, a minutes step's amount to log or to reopen the step at, or a habit's checklist item, whose key ticks one set.

text.description: What a board draws for the row. A tick row's text ends on its sets today, as `· 2 of 5 sets`, so a board that reads text alone still shows them.

group.description: The lane that a completing row sits in, such as pursuits or habits. Null on every other row.

minutes.description: The amount that a minutes step's row logs or reopens the step at. Null on every other row.

suggested.description: On the suggestion's rows, and on the amount that a minutes step offers first.

ticks.description: A checklist item's sets today, as the view was read. Null on every other row.

target.description: A checklist item's sets a day. Null on every other row.

untick_key.description: The key that takes a checklist item's latest set back. Null on every other row.

picks.description: The running picks of the row's key and untick_key, then how each one that ended came out, in the order picked.

nudge.description: The nudge that is ready to answer, with the key that picks each answer. Null where no nudge is ready.

key.description: What `panel pick` takes to answer the nudge.

picks.description: Every running pick, then each one that ended while the panel still shows it, in the order picked. A done or uncertain pick shows until a view read begins after it ended. A refused or skipped one shows until its key is picked again, or a view read begins on a later day.

picked.description: The keys picked on this desk since the view was read, each held from a second pick until a read drops what it completed.

minutes.description: The timed pursuit that a minutes step logs. The step's rows log an amount, or reopen the step one adjustment above or below it. Null on every other step.

key.description: The key of the pursuit or item the minutes log.
